login.title: Sign in
password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
password.done: Password changed. Other sign-ins with the old password have ended.
pages.label: Pages
fir.title: FIR {no}/{year}
fir.withheld: Complaint text withheld: this case protects the victim's identity (BNS 72). Only the case team can read it.
deadline.chargesheet_custody: Chargesheet for an accused in custody
deadline.sexual_offence_investigation: Investigation of a sexual offence to be completed
desk.intro: Write the information down in the informant's own words, read it over to them, and have them sign it (BNSS 173(1)). The steps of the first hour start from the time it was received.
desk.needWords: Write the information in the informant's words.
desk.name: Informant's name
desk.words: Information as given (in the informant's words)
mode.written: Written and signed by the informant
outcome.ncr: Non-cognizable: entered in the NCR register
outcome.transferred: Sent to the police station with jurisdiction
outcome.not_signed_in_time: Electronic information not signed within three days
complaint.title: Complaint of {name}
complaint.readBack: Read over to the informant in {language}, admitted correct and signed
complaint.recorded: {how}; recorded by {officer} on {date}. The text can no longer change.
copy.label: Copy for the informant
copy.title: Copy for the informant (BNSS 173(2), free of cost)
steps.title: First steps
outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.firAfterSign: An FIR can be registered once the informant has signed.
sign.spokenTitle: Read over to the informant and signed
sign.confirmSpoken: Confirm that the text above was read over to the informant, that they agreed it is what they said, and that they signed it.
sign.final: After this the text cannot be changed.
readiness.title: Readiness check
readiness.notJudging: This lists what the case file contains. It does not judge anyone.
readiness.checks: Checks for a person to confirm
holders.title: Account holders
holders.none: No accused is marked as an account holder.
io.change: Give the case to another IO
io.needReason: Give the reason for changing the IO (at least 10 characters).
io.label: Investigating officer
cert.partA: Part A (person in charge of the device)
cert.noMatch: does not match the seizure hash
cert.badSha: A SHA-256 hash has 64 characters (0-9, a-f).
cert.samePart: A correction must be for the same part as the certificate it replaces.
cert.needReason: Say why the certificate is corrected (at least 10 characters).
cert.hash: Hash as written on the certificate
arrest.heading: Arrests
arrest.remandDate: Date of first remand by the magistrate
arrest.remandNote: This decides the last day to file the chargesheet and cannot be changed after saving. Check it against the remand order.
arrest.releaseNote: Check it against the court's order. It cannot be changed after saving.
arrest.correctTitle: Correct the remand, punishment or release
arrest.releasedEmpty: Released on (leave empty if not released)
arrest.correctNote: The earlier entry stays on record with your reason. The deadline is worked out again from what you save here.
arrest.memoTitle: Correct the place, grounds or informed person
arrest.needGrounds: Write the grounds of arrest told to the person (BNSS 47).
arrest.grounds: Grounds of arrest told to the person (one per line)
arrest.memoNote: The earlier memo stays on record with your reason. The person arrested cannot be changed; use “{time}” for the time.
arrest.timeNote: The earlier time stays on record with your reason. The date of arrest decides the earliest date a remand or release can have.
arrest.csFiledLate: Chargesheet naming {label} filed on {date}, after the last day.
arrest.releasedLine: Released {how} on {date}: the custody limit no longer runs.
arrest.noHint: No suggestion: {sections} not in the punishment table yet. Check the Act yourself.
arrest.hint: From the sections ({sections}) the table suggests {pun} ({days} days). The table is a draft; check it.
arrest.hintDiffers: You chose {pun} ({days} days), which differs. Check the sections before saving.
arrest.accusedFirst: Add the person as an accused first; only an accused can be arrested.
arrest.remandIfKnown: Date of first remand (if already known)
arrest.formNote: You are recorded as the arresting officer. A wrong place, ground or informed person can be corrected later with a reason.
arrest.lineOld: {label}: arrested {date} at {place}, officer not in the old record
arrest.remandLine: First remand {date}: chargesheet within {days} days, last day
arrest.remandLineBy: First remand {date} (recorded by {name}): chargesheet within {days} days, last day
arrest.earlierDays: {days} days already spent in custody before an earlier release are counted
arrest.noRemand: First remand not recorded yet: the chargesheet deadline starts from it.
arrest.memoFixLine: Memo corrected {date} by {name}: place {place}; grounds {grounds}{informed}. Reason: {reason}
arrest.timeFixLine: Time of arrest corrected {date} by {name}: {time}. Reason: {reason}
cs.heading: Chargesheets
cs.needAccused: Tick the accused this chargesheet names.
cs.correctNote: The earlier entry stays on record with your reason; only the new one counts for the deadlines.
cs.formTitle: Record a chargesheet filed in court
cs.formNote: Entries are kept as written; fix a mistake with “{correct}”. A supplementary chargesheet is recorded as a new one.
closure.heading: Closure report
closure.notTold: informant not yet recorded as told
closure.decisionNote: Recorded once and kept as written. It changes no deadline; a chargesheet can still be recorded if further investigation is ordered.
closure.correctNote: The earlier entry stays on record with your reason; the newest counts.
closure.formTitle: Record a closure report (no chargesheet will be filed)
closure.formNote: Kept as written and recorded once. It ends the two-month limit of BNSS 193(2) but not the custody limit; record the release of anyone still in custody. Not possible while a chargesheet stands.
